title: Sulfonylureas: therapeutic uses (R-10021)
description: Sulfonylureas are drugs whose mechanism of action is: stimulate the pancreas to release more insulin. Therapeutic uses include type 2 diabetes. Prescribers choose this class when these conditions call for its mechanism. Example drugs include glipizide, glyburide, glimepiride.

spec.mechanism: stimulate the pancreas to release more insulin
spec.educational: Educational reference only; not medical advice. No dosage information is stored in this database.
